title: Diphtheria — Guinea
summary: WHO described a resurgence in Guinea from June 2025. The report lists 476 suspected cases, 70 confirmed cases and 123 deaths for 1 January–2 November. Cases were concentrated in Kankan region, particularly Siguiri; suspected and confirmed counts are distinct. Report published 2025-11-21.
